effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 yellow Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost. [On Play] effects of Tamers played by this effect don't activate.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While you have 3 or more yellow Tamers, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
